_note: Indicative macro / policy calendar for the Market Intelligence page. Refresh quarterly. Verify exact dates on RBI (rbi.org.in), MoSPI (mospi.gov.in), Federal Reserve (federalreserve.gov), and BLS (bls.gov). Format: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), all-day events. `tier`: A+ = market-moving (RBI/Fed policy), A = high-impact (GDP/CPI/NFP), B = scheduled (IIP, manufacturing PMI).

events.title: India CPI (April)
events.notes: Headline + core. Watch for sub-4.5% reading to confirm RBI room for further easing.

events.title: India IIP (March)
events.notes: Industrial production growth. Capital goods sub-index is the manufacturing-cycle bellwether.

events.title: India GDP (Q4 FY26 + FY26 advance)
events.notes: Quarter + full-year advance estimate. Consensus tracking ~6.7% for FY26.

events.title: US NFP (May)
events.notes: Non-farm payrolls + unemployment + wages. Sets Fed's June meeting bias.

events.title: RBI MPC Decision (Jun)
events.notes: Bi-monthly review. Repo rate, stance, and forward guidance. Banks/NBFCs and rate-sensitives react.

events.title: US CPI (May)
events.notes: Core CPI is the dollar/INR pair driver. Hot print pressures EM equities.

events.title: India CPI (May)
events.notes: Watch food inflation given monsoon onset uncertainty.

events.title: FOMC Decision (Jun)
events.notes: Fed funds rate decision + SEP dot plot. Direct Nifty/INR impact at 23:30 IST.
